items.text: Emva kwalokhu uJesu wasuka waya ngaphetsheya kolwandle lwaseGalili olungolwaseTiberiyasi.
Lamlandela ixuku elikhulu, ngoba lalibone izibonakaliso azenza kulabo abagulayo.
UJesu wenyukela entabeni, wahlala phansi khona labafundi bakhe.
IPhasika, umkhosi wabaJuda, lalisondele.
Wathi uJesu ephakamisa amehlo akhe, wabona ixuku elikhulu lisiza kuye, wathi kuFiliphu: Sizakuthenga ngaphi izinkwa ukuze lababantu badle na?
Watsho lokhu emlinga, ngoba yena wayekwazi azakukwenza.
UFiliphu wamphendula wathi: Izinkwa zamadola angamatshumi amabili zingebanele ukuba ilowo lalowo azuze ingcosana nje.
Omunye wabafundi bakhe, uAndreya umfowabo kaSimoni Petro, wathi kuye:
Kukhona umfana lapha olezinkwa ezinhlanu
, lenhlanzi ezimbili; kodwa ziyini kwabanengi kangaka na?
UJesu wathi: Bahlaliseni phansi. Kwakukhona utshani obunengi kuleyondawo. Ngakho amadoda ahlala phansi, ubunengi bawo babungaba zinkulungwane ezinhlanu.
UJesu wasezithatha izinkwa, esebongile wababela labo ababehlezi phansi; lenhlanzi wababela, njengokuthanda kwabo.
Bathi sebedlile basutha, wathi kubafundi bakhe: Buthani imvuthuluka eseleyo ukuze kungachitheki lutho.
Basebebutha, bagcwalisa izitsha ezilitshumi lambili ngemvuthuluka yezinkwa ezinhlanu
eyasalayo kulabo abadlayo.
Kwathi abantu bebona isimangaliso asenzileyo, bathi: Impela lo nguye umProfethi omele ukuza emhlabeni.
Kwathi uJesu esebona ukuthi bazakuza, bambambe ngamandla ukumbeka abe yinkosi, wamonyukela futhi entabeni eyedwa.
Sekuhlwile abafundi bakhe behlela olwandle,
bangena emkolweni, baqala ukuwelela ngaphetsheya kolwandle ukuya eKapenawume. Kwasekumnyama, uJesu wayengakafiki kibo.
Lwavuka ulwandle, ngoba umoya olamandla wawuvunguza.
Sebegwedlile amakhilomitha amane ingabe amahlanu, babona uJesu ehamba phezu kolwandle, esondela emkolweni; bethuka.
Kodwa wathi kibo: Yimi, lingesabi.
Kwang’khona bevuma ukumamukela emkolweni, wasufika umkolo elizweni ababesiya kilo.
Ngakusasa ixuku elalimi ngaphetsheya kolwandle labona ukuthi umkolo wawumunye lapho, lokuthi uJesu wayengangenanga emkolweni kanye labafundi bakhe, kodwa abafundi bakhe babehambe bodwa.
Kodwa imikolo evela eTiberiyasi yafika eduze lendawo lapho badla khona isinkwa, emva kokuba iNkosi isibongile.
Kwathi abantu sebebonile ukuthi uJesu wayengekho lapho kanye labafundi bakhe, bangena emikolweni, baya eKapenawume bedinga uJesu.
Bathi sebemfumene ngaphetsheya kolwandle bathi kuye: Mfundisi, ufike nini lapha na?
UJesu wabaphendula wathi: Ngiqinisile, ngiqinisile ngithi kini: Kalingidingi ngoba labona izibonakaliso, kodwa ngoba ladla lasutha izinkwa.
Lingasebenzeli ukudla okuphelayo kodwa sebenzelani ukudla okuhlala kuze kube yikuphila okungapheliyo, ezakulinika khona iNdodana yomuntu; ngoba uNkulunkulu uYise ubeke kuyo uphawu lwakhe.
Basebesithi kuye: Sizakwenzani ukuze senze imisebenzi kaNkulunkulu?
UJesu wabaphendula wathi: Umsebenzi kaNkulunkulu yiwo lo ukuba likholwe kuye amthumileyo.
Ngakho bathi kuye: Pho, wenza isibonakaliso bani ukuba sibone, sikholwe kuwe na? Usebenzani na?
Okhokho badla imana
Eks 16:4
Hubo 78:24
enkangala njengokulotshiweyo ukuthi: Wabanika isinkwa esivela ezulwini ukuba badle.
UJesu wasesithi kibo: Ngiqinisile, ngiqinisile ngithi kini: Kwakungesuye uMose owalinika isinkwa esivela ezulwini, kodwa uBaba ulinika isinkwa soqobo esivela ezulwini.
Ngoba isinkwa sikaNkulunkulu siyiso esehla sivela ezulwini, esinika ukuphila emhlabeni.
Basebesithi kuye: Nkosi, sinike lesosinkwa njalonjalo.
UJesu wathi kibo: Isinkwa sokuphila yimi; lowo oza kimi kasezukulamba, lalowo okholwa kimi kasezukoma.
Kodwa ngithe kini: Lingibonile, kodwa kalikholwa.
Bonke uBaba anginika bona bazakuza kimi; lozayo kimi angisoze ngimxotshe isibili.
Ngoba ngehlile ezulwini kungasukuba ngenze intando yami, kodwa ngenze intando yalowo ongithumileyo.
Lokhu kuyintando yalowo ongithumileyo ukuba ngingalahlekelwa langoyedwa wabo bonke anginike bona, kodwa ngibavuse ngosuku lokucina.
Ngoba lokhu kuyintando kaBaba ukuthi ilowo lalowo obona iNdodana, akholwe kiyo, abe lokuphila okungapheliyo; ngizakumvusa ngosuku lokucina.
AbaJuda basebemsola, ngoba wathi: Ngiyisinkwa esehla ezulwini.
Bathike: Lo kasuye uJesu indodana kaJosefa, uyise lonina esibaziyo na? Utsho kanjani pho, ukuthi: Ngehle ngivela ezulwini, na?
UJesu wabaphendula wathi: Lingasoli phakathi kwenu.
Kakho ongeza kimi, uba uBaba ongithumileyo engamdonsi; mina ngizakumvusa ngosuku lokucina.
Kulotshiwe kubaprofethi ukuthi: Bonke bazakufundiswa nguNkulunkulu. Ilowo lalowo omzwileyo uBaba, wafunda, uyeza kimi.
Kayisikho ukuthi ukhona ombonileyo uBaba, kuphela yena ovela kuNkulunkulu; nguye ombonileyo uBaba.
Ngiqinisile, ngiqinisile ngithi kini: Yena okholwayo ulokuphila okungapheliyo.
Mina ngiyisinkwa sokuphila.
Okhokho benu badla
enkangala, kodwa bafa.
Ngikhuluma ngesinkwa esehla sivela ezulwini ukuba umuntu asidle sona, angafi.
Mina ngiyisinkwa esiphilayo esehla sivela ezulwini. Uba umuntu esidla lesisinkwa, uzakuphila kokuphela; isinkwa engizakusinika siyinyama yami engizakuyinikela ngenxa yokuphila komhlaba.
AbaJuda basebephikisana bodwa, besithi: Lo angasinika kanjani inyama yakhe, siyidle na?
Ngakho uJesu wasesithi kibo: Ngiqinisile, ngiqinisile ngithi kini: Uba lingadli inyama yeNdodana yomuntu, linathe igazi layo, kalilakuphila phakathi kwenu.
Odla inyama yami, anathe igazi lami, ulokuphila okungapheliyo; ngizakumvusa ngosuku lokucina.
Ngoba inyama yami iyikudla isibili, legazi lami lingokunathwayo isibili.
Odla inyama yami, anathe igazi lami, uhlala kimi, lami ngihlala kuye.
Njengalokhu uBaba ophilayo ungithumile, lami ngiphila ngoBaba, ngakho ongidlayo laye uzakuphila ngami.
Lesi yisinkwa esehla sivela ezulwini kungenjengesinkwa okhokho benu abasidlayo, bafa; yena odla lesisinkwa uzakuphila kokuphela.
Watsho lezizinto esinagogeni efundisa eKapenawume.
Kwathi abanengi kubafundi bakhe besizwa lokhu bathi: Lilukhuni lelilizwi; ngubani ongalizwa na?
Kodwa uJesu esazi phakathi kwakhe ukuthi abafundi bakhe bayasola ngalokhu, wathi kibo: Kuyaliconula lokhu na?
Pho, lizakuthini uba libona iNdodana yomuntu isenyukela lapho yayikhona kuqala na?
Kungumoya onika ukuphila, inyama kayisizi lutho; amazwi esengiwakhulume kini angumoya, ayikuphila.
Kodwa bakhona abanye kini abangakholwayo. Ngoba uJesu wakwazi ekuqaleni ukuba ngobani abangakholwayo lokuba ngubani ozakumnikela.
Wasesithi: Kungenxa yalokhu ngithe kini: Kakho ongeza kimi engakunikwanga nguBaba.
Emva kwalokhu abanengi babafundi bakhe babuyela emuva, kababe besahamba laye.
UJesu wasesithi kwabalitshumi lambili: Lani lithanda ukuzihambela na?
USimoni Petro wamphendula wathi: Nkosi, sizakuya kubani na? Amazwi okuphila okungapheliyo akuwe.
Mark 8:29
Luka 9:20
Siyakholwa, sesisazi ukuthi wena ungoNgcwele kaNkulunkulu.
UJesu wabaphendula wathi: Kanti kangilikhethanga lina abalitshumi lambili na? Kodwake omunye wenu ungumoya omubi.
Wayekhuluma ngoJudasi indodana kaSimoni Iskariyothi, ngoba nguye owayezakumnikela engomunye wabalitshumi lambili.
